register: Additional-family record: 25 additional GROUPS= candidates, fingerprinted against the 11 registered candidates + the 10-algorithm RANUNI grid arm on (n=503, g=10, seed=8675309), screened x {cid_asc, score_asc} on the 4 sharpest bound-exact 2024 targets (C01/C02/C04/C08, ward_tie arm, reconciled membership); extension bar: snap>=3/4 on >=2 targets; snap = |group mean - published| < 0.5 per boundary; n_exact = round_display equality at published display precision

definitions.sub_add_floyd: per-group MT substream seeded seed+g (g=1..10); group sizes remainder-last; per group, Floyd ordered-hash SRS (groups_assign.floyd_sample, randint=floor(u*j)+1) from the remaining units in original order
definitions.sub_add_sortsrs: per-group MT substream seeded seed+g; per group, one uniform per remaining unit (current remaining order), the sz smallest join the group
definitions.sub_mul_floyd: as sub_add_floyd with substream seed (seed*g) mod 2^31
definitions.sub_mul_sortsrs: as sub_add_sortsrs with substream seed (seed*g) mod 2^31
definitions.sub_hash_floyd: as sub_add_floyd with substream seed = low 31 bits of first 4 bytes of sha256('{seed},{g}')
definitions.sub_hash_sortsrs: as sub_add_sortsrs with the sha256 substream seed
definitions.serp_MT_asc: one SasMT(seed) uniform per obs; sort obs by uniform ascending (stable); deal labels boustrophedon starting 1..10 then 10..1 alternating
definitions.serp_RANUNI_asc: as serp_MT_asc with the SasRanuni(seed) stream
definitions.serp_RANUNI_desc: as serp_MT_desc with the SasRanuni(seed) stream
definitions.plan_rank_MT: blocks of 10 consecutive obs in dataset order; per block draw 10 SasMT uniforms, label of block position i = rank of its uniform (1-based); last partial block takes the first r labels
definitions.plan_rank_RANUNI: as plan_rank_MT with the SasRanuni(seed) stream
definitions.plan_fy_MT: blocks of 10 consecutive obs; per block labels a[i]+1 with a = fisher_yates(rng,10,'down') (randint=floor(u*j)+1) on the SasMT(seed) stream; partial block takes first r labels
definitions.plan_fy_RANUNI: as plan_fy_MT with the SasRanuni(seed) stream
definitions.floyd_u32mod: floyd_last structure (single SasMT(seed) stream, sizes remainder-last) with randint(1..j) = (raw u32 mod j)+1
definitions.floyd_u32rej: floyd_last structure with rejection randint: redraw while u32 >= floor(2^32/j)*j, then (u32 mod j)+1
definitions.fyup_u32mod: Fisher-Yates up (i=2..n, swap(i, randint(1..i))) + contiguous blocks remainder-last, randint = (u32 mod j)+1
definitions.fyup_u32rej: as fyup_u32mod with the rejection randint
definitions.fydown_u32mod: Fisher-Yates down (i=n..2) + contiguous blocks remainder-last, randint = (u32 mod j)+1
definitions.fydown_u32rej: as fydown_u32mod with the rejection randint
definitions.hyb_sortRANUNI_quotaMT: sort obs by SasRanuni(seed) uniforms (asc, stable); walk sorted order assigning by sequential quota (remainder-last) with SasMT(seed) uniforms
definitions.hyb_sortMT_quotaRANUNI: sort obs by SasMT(seed) uniforms; sequential quota draws from SasRanuni(seed)
definitions.hyb_reseedMT_sortblocks: legacy-seed reseed: seed' = 397204094*seed mod (2^31-1) (first RANUNI state; 959153317 for 8675309); sort-blocks remainder-last under SasMT(seed')
definitions.hyb_reseedMT_floyd: same reseed seed'; registered floyd_last (groups_assign.floyd_groups) under SasMT(seed')
definitions.hyb_reseedRANUNI_sortblocks: seed'' = first SasMT(seed) u32 mod (2^31-1), +1 if 0; sort-blocks remainder-last under SasRanuni(seed'')
